themes.title: Deduction and comparison
themes.description: Use a match, a weighing or a clue to narrow down possible answers.

themes.title: Sets, combinations and chance
themes.description: Classify cards by their attributes, then reason about combinations.

themes.title: Winning positions
themes.description: Choose a move, predict a reply and look for a strategy that repeats.

themes.title: Sequences of moves
themes.description: Plan a route through constrained states and compare the moves needed.

themes.title: Routes and networks
themes.description: Compare routes through a village, then draw paths subject to network rules.

themes.title: Tiling and packing
themes.description: Cover rectangles with squares, compare packings and investigate repeated square removal.

themes.title: Area and dissection
themes.description: Fix a boundary, join squares and rearrange shapes to compare their areas.

themes.title: Curves and geometric models
themes.description: Construct circles, trace moving points and investigate curved paths and surfaces.

themes.title: Spatial structures
themes.description: Inspect cube layers, construct frameworks and investigate a passage through a solid.

themes.title: Products and factors
themes.description: Start with multiplication facts, build arrays and cuboids, then reason about factors and divisors.

themes.title: Patterns and change
themes.description: Look for patterns in a table, combine values and predict the next result.

themes.title: Pictures and rules
themes.description: Use cells, parts and repeated rules to build a picture or character.

themes.title: Story worlds
themes.description: Arrange characters and objects, compare sizes and build a scene to describe.

themes.title: Programs and instructions
themes.description: Sequence commands for a route, debug a grid program and follow a tape machine.

themes.title: Codes and ciphers
themes.description: Rearrange a message, explore substitution and compare a changing cipher.

themes.title: Word patterns
themes.description: Build words from a letter set and use positional clues to rule out guesses.

activities.title: Mastermind
activities.description: Match colours and use a single clue to rule out a guess; begin with fewer holes and colours.
activities.readinessNote: score/filter/partitions implement clue-based elimination.

activities.title: Goat & boat
activities.description: Carry one item, predict what can safely stay together, and explain why an empty return might help.
activities.readinessNote: crossingMoves and unsafe generate legal states.

activities.title: Tower of Hanoi
activities.description: Move two or three discs legally and notice which smaller discs must move first.
activities.readinessNote: 2026-11-18 · Select peg A then C, undo, 3 and 8 discs; golden discs/pegs; 390 px iframe control wrap and peg selection.

activities.title: Dobble
activities.description: Make three cards using stickers, then check every pair shares exactly one symbol.
activities.readinessNote: Recorded checks cover finite-plane decks and pair matches in a simulated document. Physical-device play has not been verified here.

activities.title: Find a SET
activities.description: Choose three cards whose features are all the same or all different, one feature at a time.
activities.readinessNote: Session.setDeck builds 3^d distinct vectors.

activities.title: 15 game
activities.description: Take numbers 1–9 and find three that total 15 using physical number cards if useful.
activities.readinessNote: Session.winningTriple enumerates triples.

activities.title: Take-away strategy
activities.description: Take one or two counters and predict who takes the last; change one rule.
activities.readinessNote: Session.nimWins computes win/loss positions by dynamic programming.

activities.title: Memory pairs
activities.description: Match visible representations in a small four-pair deck and describe the relationship.
activities.readinessNote: choose checks paired identities and preserves matched positions.

activities.title: Mystery weights
activities.description: Compare two unknown weights, record which is lighter and arrange four objects.
activities.readinessNote: Session.sortTrace generates selection/insertion comparisons.

activities.title: Which card stays?
activities.description: Lay out a few cards in a circle and alternate keeping/removing; predict the survivor.
activities.readinessNote: Circle player/card state is separate from survivor display.

activities.title: Twisty cube
activities.description: Turn a face, reverse it and compare the coloured net with a physical cube.
activities.readinessNote: Core.turn rotates face-layer positions and normals.

activities.title: Which hand wins?
activities.description: Compare repeated numbers and ordered ranks using example hands.
activities.readinessNote: Core.rank5 handles straights including low ace and tie breakers.

activities.title: Chase & escape
activities.description: Make points chase one another, change a speed and describe the traces.
activities.readinessNote: visual.js towards/tick advance positions.

activities.title: Sprouts
activities.description: Join two dots without crossing and add a new dot; begin with one or two dots.
activities.readinessNote: The game checks drawn routes; players agree when no legal move remains. No complete legal-move solver is implemented.

activities.title: Painted cubes
activities.description: Paint a large cube, rotate it and sort small cubes by how many painted faces they have.
activities.readinessNote: Small-cube face flags determine classification.

activities.title: Curve lab
activities.description: Build a ramp from points, race a ball against a straight slope and predict which wins.
activities.readinessNote: race and numerical path-time functions drive comparisons.

activities.title: String lab
activities.description: Join straight strings, twist a rod tower and notice the curved surface.
activities.readinessNote: lab.js has separate nail/hyperbola/saddle/tower models.

activities.title: Square it up
activities.description: Remove the largest square that fits a rectangle and keep going.
activities.readinessNote: Largest-square subtraction updates remainder and records divisions.

activities.title: Inside the gallery
activities.description: Rotate and shrink repeated picture frames and notice similar copies.
activities.readinessNote: Recorded checks cover the complex identity, the excluded origin and gallery modes in a simulated document. The checks do not cover rendering on a physical device.

activities.title: Packing lab
activities.description: Place rectangles or whole squares in a box and compare arrangements.
activities.readinessNote: 19 November 2026 · In desktop Chromium, Rotate and Enter placed one of four pieces. See a packing showed a four-piece result with the first diagram and step controls. A separate controller test completes the board and replays the solution. Physical-tablet play has not been checked.

activities.title: Circle lab
activities.description: Drag a point on a semicircle and measure the angle; compare many examples.
activities.readinessNote: Drag models and optional measurement/guides update together.

activities.title: Polyomino studio
activities.description: Join squares edge to edge, rotate a piece and decide whether it is new.
activities.readinessNote: Canonical key removes rotational/reflected duplicates.

activities.title: Cut & rearrange
activities.description: Cut a shape into pieces, slide/turn them and cover a target.
activities.readinessNote: Cuts split polygons.

activities.title: Fewest squares
activities.description: Cover a small rectangle with whole squares, count them and try to improve.
activities.readinessNote: 19 November 2026 · In desktop Chromium, Enter placed a 2 × 2 square on a 3 × 5 board, Undo reversed it and the next activity link opened Packing Lab. A separate controller test completes and saves a tiling. Physical-tablet play has not been checked.

activities.title: 36 fences
activities.description: Use a fixed number of fence pieces to enclose a garden and count its squares.
activities.readinessNote: Boundary checks reject branches/open paths.

activities.title: Cube through a cube
activities.description: Slide a cut-out from a yellow cube, then pass a blue cube through and inspect the hole.
activities.readinessNote: 2026-11-18 · Cube renderer visible, cut-out slider to End, blue cube Halfway, keyboard rotation; blue/yellow and light scene. WebGL versus CPU fallback not separately forced.

activities.title: Paper surprises
activities.description: Predict what a paper loop will do, cut a real strip and compare the result.
activities.readinessNote: Prediction notebook and comparison explanations exist.

activities.title: Bridge lab
activities.description: Build triangles between supports and observe what changes when a load moves.
activities.readinessNote: The audited editor starts from truss templates. Test the design and simulation together on the intended device.

activities.title: Number patterns
activities.description: Click squares to mark a pattern, then compare multiples, squares or primes.
activities.readinessNote: 2026-11-18 · Switch to remainder colours and numbers + remainders; purple/yellow visible; 390 px iframe responsive controls.

activities.title: Factor shapes
activities.description: Adjust two or three whole-number sides until the area/volume reaches a chosen target.
activities.readinessNote: Save requires exact product.

activities.title: Factor trees
activities.description: Split a composite number into two factors and continue until every leaf is prime.
activities.readinessNote: Split requires both factors greater than one and correct product.

activities.title: Explore 30 cubes
activities.description: Use 30 small cubes to make boxes and record their side lengths.
activities.readinessNote: Only exact volume 30 saves.

activities.title: Money plants
activities.description: Grow a seed, harvest coins and keep a day-by-day table with small starting numbers.
activities.readinessNote: advance separates daily phases.

activities.title: Times tables
activities.description: Choose a small group of facts, use an array when stuck and explain a division fact.
activities.readinessNote: 19 November 2026 · Desktop Chromium confirmed correct keypad feedback and score for 5 × 3. After Start at 820 × 1180, 1180 × 820 and 390 × 844 CSS pixels, the question and full keypad stayed visible, the answer field stayed read-only and the page fitted the width. Physical-tablet input remains untested.

activities.title: Multiply to the target
activities.description: Multiply a shared running number by a choice from 2–9 and try to reach a target.
activities.readinessNote: Core.winningMultiplier recursively finds winning moves with memoisation.

activities.title: Different totals
activities.description: Fill cells with −1, 0 or 1 and compare row and column sums.
activities.readinessNote: strategy.js recomputes row/column totals and checks uniqueness after cell edits.

activities.title: Divisor game
activities.description: Choose a number and identify which remaining proper divisors go to the other player.
activities.readinessNote: Core.divisors excludes the chosen number itself.

activities.title: Add to your neighbours
activities.description: Remove a middle number and add it to both neighbours; compare final totals.
activities.readinessNote: Core.remove disallows endpoints.

activities.title: Code grid
activities.description: Tap commands to move an emoji to a goal; use a short visible loop.
activities.readinessNote: Command blocks form nested instruction structures.

activities.title: Build a robot
activities.description: Choose body parts, vary sizes and describe what changed.
activities.readinessNote: Body/limb proportions and palette controls update drawing.

activities.title: Pixel art
activities.description: Paint squares and make a mirror image or repeating pattern.
activities.readinessNote: visual.js paint modifies cells and mirror counterparts.

activities.title: Secret messages
activities.description: Shift letters around a wheel and decode a short message.
activities.readinessNote: words.js shift normalises letter offsets modulo 26.

activities.title: Creature studio
activities.description: Add body segments and pairs of legs, then draw a route for the creature.
activities.readinessNote: Route sampling drives body orientation.

activities.title: Scytale
activities.description: Wrap a message strip around a cylinder, then unwrap and compare the letter order.
activities.readinessNote: Wrap parameter maps positions to cylinder/flat strip.

activities.title: Shark family
activities.description: Build a family, compare sizes and add underwater objects.
activities.readinessNote: Character and scenery controls alter scene objects.

activities.title: Dragon world
activities.description: Create a dragon scene, compare wings and bodies and describe positions.
activities.readinessNote: Object editing, scene creation and save/export controls are wired.

activities.title: Dinosaur world
activities.description: Arrange dinosaurs from small to large or create a repeating landscape.
activities.readinessNote: Character drawing options and scene-object controls update saved scene state.

activities.title: Turing tape
activities.description: Act out a simple tape rule, step once and say what changed.
activities.readinessNote: TapeMachine.step applies write/move/next transitions.

activities.title: Robot trails
activities.description: Put forward and turn pieces together to collect stars, then wrap a repeated section in a loop.
activities.readinessNote: Program interpreter handles repeat blocks and height changes.

activities.title: Enigma explorer
activities.description: Type one letter, trace its path and compare what happens after a rotor steps.
activities.readinessNote: Update reprocesses from starting settings.

activities.title: Magic village
activities.description: Choose a project, move cargo or plan a short route and earn in-world gold.
activities.readinessNote: Route permutations and cargo shortest-path search are implemented.

activities.title: Spelling Bee
activities.description: Build words using a fixed set of letters including a required centre letter.
activities.readinessNote: Published as a word game; curriculum alignment has not been reviewed.

activities.title: Five-letter words
activities.description: Use a letter clue to rule out a proposed five-letter word.
activities.readinessNote: Published as a word game; curriculum alignment has not been reviewed.
